text: Travel experiences can change us in many ways. When planning a trip, we often feel excited about visiting new places. One of the best parts of travelling is experiencing new cultures. We can try different food, listen to local music, and learn about traditions that are very different from our own. Sometimes, we face language barriers, which can be difficult, but they often lead to funny moments. Even simple things, like ordering coffee, can become an adventure. In the end, these moments create memories that we keep forever. Travelling teaches us about the world and also about ourselves.
